verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS remote-access product with AI features like Session Insights and Tia, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents configurable retention periods or deletion of session, AI, or account data. The audit log and the Web API are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
